cpu_validation.note: Only synthetic CPU contracts and hash-verified AST-extracted official pure helpers were executed. The source-review scratch files and test outputs are not distributed. The new CPU test file is included in pyproject.toml testpaths.

instructions: No weights or native dependencies are part of the CPU package. Only the resource coordinator may stage assets and launch native checks.

Use separate clean source checkouts and environments: retain the original N3 source/config unchanged. E3 official setup uses the policy-server dependency group; F3 setup uses encoders, serve, torch/CUDA-compatible NATTEN. See each pinned source docs/setup.md or docs/action_policy_droid_server.md.

Hash verification uses Hugging Face immutable tree metadata. sha256 is the LFS content OID; git_blob is SHA1(blob <byte_count> NUL <content>), not a raw SHA1. All listed runtime assets must exist locally. No automatic downloads, quantization, variant selection or fallback models.

Invoke the checkpoint-specific interpreter with -m experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.checkpoint_wrapper_entrypoint E3 (or F3). PYTHONPATH must include the study checkout and the selected official source (F3 src/).
Set SGW01_E3_SOURCE_ROOT and SGW01_E3_CHECKPOINT_PATH; E3 also requires SGW01_E3_OUTPUT_DIR to an explicit persistent output directory, never the upstream temporary default.

For F3 set SGW01_F3_SOURCE_ROOT, SGW01_F3_CHECKPOINT_PATH to the root BF16 package and SGW01_F3_BASE_PATH to the separately verified base encoders snapshot. No variants subfolder is allowed. Preparation is eager (compile=False), warmup=0, no text offload; single_frame_encode becomes True through the official preparation API.

Both require SGW01_<MODEL>_HOST=127.0.0.1, SGW01_<MODEL>_PORT, SGW01_SERVER_ATTESTATION, SGW01_TRACE_SIDECAR, SGW01_FUTURE_DIR. The existing owner also needs SGW01_SERVER_ARGV (JSON argv), SGW01_RUNTIME_RECEIPT (new path), SGW01_SERVER_LOG_DIR, SGW01_ENV_FACTORY, SGW01_CAMERA_NAME and a finite SGW01_READINESS_TIMEOUT appropriate to cold model loading.

Use the existing runtime.create_runtime owner, not a pre-existing remote service. It verifies the child PID/start/cmdline, socket ownership and checkpoint-specific attestation. This receipt does not qualify a runtime or release a queue.

The wrapper forces HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 before any model import. Missing auxiliary dependencies fail closed. Request seeds are the frozen effective_policy_seed, explicitly passed to each native request, not inferred from a server query counter.

Only the existing three camera slots and measured arm joints/gripper enter the model. E3 keeps its official compose-then-bilinear-resize path. F3 uses its official compose_views and _resize_uint8 to adapt registered native frames to its required 540x640 composite, then its official reflect-pad to 544x736. This is a prospective F3 native-frame binding, not inherited N3/D1 qualification or a claim of equality to the PIL-based RoboLab client.

Both return 32 absolute seven-joint targets in radians plus DROID gripper closed fraction. The exact returned prefix is executed, at most 32 steps or the remaining 450-action budget. No delta integration, unit rescaling, extra gripper flip or client-side binarization is added.

E3 explicitly uses its documented guidance_interval=[960,1001] and structured JSON prompt formatter, guidance=3, unipc/4 steps/shift=5, history=1, conditioning_fps=15, resolution=480. The literal instruction reaches the official formatter unchanged.

F3 keeps root BF16 sampler cosmos_unipc/order2, 4 steps, shift=5, video CFG=4, action CFG=1, action_scale=2, absolute units, gripper_flip_dims=[-1], 15Hz and 32 returned/executed actions. Its official policy undoes scale and gripper flips before returning.

F3 captures the output of the same official _sample_prepared invocation used by RoboLabPolicy.infer, retains normalized latents and decodes them through the official video VAE; it never samples a second future. SGW01_F3_CAPTURE_FUTURE=0 disables this capture only for native capture-on/off action parity qualification. Default is 1.

Decoded predictions are explicitly decoded_unmapped; no camera/time-qualified prediction score follows from a decoded file. F3 decode exceptions preserve valid actions, sampled latents and decode_error evidence. Native checks must verify parity, decoded shape/slots, and the documented action k -> frame k+1 at 15Hz mapping before forecast analysis.

CPU source contracts can be run with SGW01_E3_SOURCE_ROOT and SGW01_F3_SOURCE_ROOT pointing to their pinned official checkouts, or SGW01_OFFICIAL_SOURCE_AUDIT pointing to a directory containing the exact reviewed filenames below (edge_server.py, flux_robolab.py, flux_policy.py, flux_packing.py, flux_positional.py). Tests AST-extract only pure helpers after SHA256 verification; no official model import or inference. Run python -m pytest -q --basetemp .sgw-adapter-tests tests/test_sgw_checkpoint_integrations.py; optional CPU torch and einops are needed for source and joint-sample contract checks.
